titulo.alumno:
«Кино: сюжет и оценка»
Film: plot and evaluation

intro: A film review can summarise the plot, analyse techniques and assess the work; do not confuse a summary of events with an aesthetic judgement.

piezas.titulo: A film review can summarise the plot, analyse techniques and assess the work; do not confuse a summary of events with an aesthetic judgement.
texto: A film review can summarise the plot, analyse techniques and assess the work; do not confuse a summary of events with an aesthetic judgement.
Look for the reasons that justify the assessment: pacing, editing, perspective, acting or narrative structure.
